purpose: Failure lessons that were learned in conversation but NOT persisted at the time. This record is the structural fix: conversation is not memory; a lesson that is not written down must be re-taught.
operational_rule: After any bug/fix that took >2 rounds of back-and-forth, write the lesson here (date, symptom, root cause, fix, pattern, prevention). Append, never overwrite. Link the gap-tracker entry.

lessons.symptom: node_census skipped days (Aug 4, Aug 10) — no census captured on those days
lessons.root_cause: Capture gated on `cycleCount % 24 === 0`; cycleCount resets on DE-server restart, so a restart silently shifted the cadence and starved daily captures
lessons.fix: Time-based gating in tools/data-engineering/agent.js Step 4d: `if (STATE.lastNodeCensusDay !== today)` — once per calendar day, robust to restarts
lessons.verified: 2026-08-11: files Aug 5→10 consecutive in captured-data/spool/index/node_census/; state key lastNodeCensusDay=2026-08-10 persisted in de-agent-state.json. Aug 4 remains a permanent historical gap (cannot be backfilled)
lessons.pattern: P-06 counter-reset: any wall-clock cadence gated on a monotonic counter breaks when the counter resets. Use wall-clock state for wall-clock schedules.
lessons.prevention: Never gate a daily capture on a counter. Persist last-run-date in state; gate on date inequality.

lessons.symptom: Research runner (5 fetcher agents) was manual-only — present only in tools/agents/run-all.js, not scheduled; findings effectively static (baseline 43, no growth) for ~9 days
lessons.root_cause: The runner existed but nothing scheduled it on a cadence; it only fired when a human ran run-all.js
lessons.fix: Wired into DE server daily cycle (agent.js Step 4f): `if (STATE.lastResearchDay !== today) researchRunner.runCycle()`; state key lastResearchDay persisted
lessons.verified: 2026-08-11: research_findings spool has daily files Jul 31→Aug 11 (12 days); 244 total records; daily report cycle 20 generated 2026-08-10T20:07Z
lessons.pattern: P-04 unshipped/unscheduled work: a capability that is not wired into the scheduler is dead, regardless of how good it is
lessons.prevention: Every agent/runner must be wired into the DE server cycle or explicitly declared manual; audit agents for scheduler membership

lessons.symptom: hashrate / mempool_recent reported as stale — '9/12 files' looked old; flagged as a data problem
lessons.root_cause: Judged freshness by file count in a directory, not by per-source capture cadence. The 9/12 was a historical file count, not a staleness measure
lessons.fix: Monitor now honors per-source expectedIntervalMinutes from spool cursors (monitor.js 2026-08-02 change): a daily source (census) gets a daily bound; a fresh source with few files is not 'stale'
lessons.verified: 2026-08-11: hashrate and mempool_recent both have files through 2026-08-11 (today); sources healthy
lessons.pattern: P-07 freshness-by-cadence: file count in a dir is not a freshness metric. Age vs the source's own expected interval is.
lessons.prevention: When evaluating data health, compare last capture age against per-source expectedIntervalMinutes, never against file counts or directory listings

lessons.symptom: GH013 — a hardcoded GitHub token got pushed; GitHub secret-scanning push protection flagged it and blocked ALL pushes to the repo
lessons.root_cause: Hardcoded token in tools/dataset-snapshot.js; no push-protection verification before push
lessons.fix: Token moved to gitignored .env.local; code reads process.env.GH_TOKEN; wrapper (dataset-snapshot.sh) sources .env.local for launchd; decision record docs/decisions/2026-08-10-token-rotation.md written; token value NOT present in any git blob (verified 2026-08-11)
lessons.verified: 2026-08-11: .env.local gitignored (git check-ignore PASS); git grep + blob scan find zero github_pat_ in history; dataset-snapshot.js reads env only
lessons.pattern: P-08 secret hygiene: secrets belong in gitignored env files, never in code. Assume any pushed secret is compromised; rotate, don't just delete.
lessons.prevention: Never hardcode secrets; run `git diff --check`-style secret scans before push; use environment variables + gitignored .env.local; on GH013: revoke token, create new, update .env.local

lessons.symptom: Spool 'staleness' misdiagnosis: btc-rpc flagged as '3 days stale' by looking at captured-data/spool/index/btc-rpc/
lessons.root_cause: Two near-identical source dirs exist: btc-rpc (hyphen, legacy, one stale file) vs btc_rpc (underscore, the real active source). Diagnosed from the wrong directory
lessons.fix: Correct diagnosis: btc_rpc (underscore) is fresh through 2026-08-10 (written 2026-08-11T01:58). No code fix needed — the source was always healthy; the diagnosis was wrong
lessons.verified: 2026-08-11: btc-rpc (hyphen) has 1 file from 2026-08-01; btc_rpc (underscore) has daily files through 2026-08-10
lessons.pattern: P-09 wrong-slot diagnosis: before declaring a source stale, confirm you are looking at the source's actual canonical location and name
lessons.prevention: When checking freshness, resolve the canonical source key from config (CONFIG.endpoints), not from a directory listing guess

lessons.fix: THIS FILE. Create telos/lessons/ as the structured lessons record; link lessons to gap-tracker entries (G-25..G-30); add operational rule (write after any >2-round fix); add P2.0 principle to AXIOMS.md
lessons.verified: 2026-08-11: lessons dir created; gap-tracker updated; master-todo section added; AXIOMS.md P2.0 added; committed + pushed
lessons.pattern: P-06 THE META-PATTERN: 'I learn in conversation but don't persist the learning into the system.' Structural fix = a lessons record every session appends to + a rule making it mandatory after costly fixes
lessons.prevention: Every session: if the session contained a bug/fix/misdiagnosis that took >2 rounds, write it to telos/lessons/ before closing. Conversation is not memory.
